scope: Controlled local services and local Hardhat EVM. Trusted endpoint accepts fixture batch root; no fresh Groth16 proof, public-chain consensus or model-quality evaluation. Recovery fixture closes and reopens SQLite/gateway at an interrupted-reconciliation boundary; the harness queries isSettled then invokes markSettled. No relayer-daemon crash or power-loss test.
concurrency: Four separate Node child processes, each with its own SQLite connection; the coordinator waits until all are armed then broadcasts start over IPC. Shared database and trusted-gateway authority. Actual start/end timestamps are retained; start broadcasts are not simultaneous atomic machine instructions.
warmup: No latency claim or latency comparison is predeclared. All task iterations are correctness observations; times are retained diagnostically.
